note: Zwei optionale Minispiele (TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE 12.8, Runde 7): ‚Der Morsetaster‘ im Stellwerk Karsk (Alexei) und ‚Rohrpost‘ im Lesesaal des Bauarchivs (Konrad). Nüchterner Ton, nie strafend, keine Ausrufezeichen. Die kyrillischen Zeilen sind Text in der Spielwelt (Telegrammformular); Alexeis Übersetzung steht daneben. Fundtexte (explore.*) in der Stimme der Hauptfigur.

strings.mg.morse.title: The Morse key
strings.mg.morse.subtitle: The man on duty is fetching tea. ‘If the set goes, you take it.’ The set goes.
strings.mg.morse.instruction: Routine traffic Alexei takes down himself. The last words you read off the chart, then you acknowledge receipt with the key.
strings.mg.morse.status.listen: The set is printing. Alexei takes down the routine part; the last words come more slowly.
strings.mg.morse.status.busy: Not until the set falls silent.
strings.mg.morse.fail.dot: That was a dash – a dot belongs here. ‘{letter}’ again from the start.
strings.mg.morse.fail.dash: That was a dot – a dash belongs here. ‘{letter}’ again from the start.
strings.mg.morse.solved: Acknowledged. The man on duty comes back with two glasses of tea. ‘Well?’ – ‘Running late.’
strings.mg.morse.hint.1: Tip: The group has {n} signs. Find the box on the chart with exactly this pattern – the same dots and dashes in the same order.
strings.mg.morse.hint.2: Tip: The matching box is now lit on the chart.
strings.mg.morse.hint.key.1: Tip: A short tap makes a dot. Holding until the bar runs past the mark makes a dash. The pauses don’t matter.
strings.mg.morse.hint.key.2: Tip: R plays the acknowledgement once. П is short – long – long – short, Р is short – long – short.
strings.mg.morse.ctrl.key: press key, hold for a dash
strings.mg.morse.form.head: ТЕЛЕГРАММА № 118 · ОТ ДНЦ · КОМУ ДСП КАРСК
strings.mg.tube.title: Pneumatic post
strings.mg.tube.subtitle: ‘Since the rebuilding, nothing arrives here any more,’ says the librarian.
strings.mg.tube.instruction: The switches are set on the board. Turn them so that the capsule from the porter’s lodge arrives in the reading room, then call it.
strings.mg.tube.route: From the porter’s lodge to the reading room.
strings.mg.tube.board.1: The board dates from 1938. Two switches lie on the route.
strings.mg.tube.board.2: The main line is frozen. The detour runs round the top, past the directorate.
strings.mg.tube.board.3: Five switches and a crossing. Not every switch lies on the route.
strings.mg.tube.content.1: A loan slip from the lodge: ‘Brehm’s Life of Animals, volume Birds. Reason for loan: ring on leg.’
strings.mg.tube.content.2: A circular from building management: ‘Who turned up the heating in the reading room? Kindly report.’
strings.mg.tube.content.3: A sandwich in greaseproof paper. In pencil on it: ‘For the reading room. You always forget to eat.’
strings.mg.tube.slot: Capsule {n} · still in the porter’s lodge
strings.mg.tube.status.ready: Set the switches, then call the capsule.
strings.mg.tube.status.travel: The capsule is on its way.
strings.mg.tube.status.arrived: The capsule drops into the reading-room basket.
strings.mg.tube.status.next: The next capsule is waiting in the porter’s lodge.
strings.mg.tube.fail.registratur: The capsule lands in the registry. There they stamp it ‘Received’ and send it back.
strings.mg.tube.fail.abt3: Department III. The capsule comes back unopened, marked ‘Misdirected’.
strings.mg.tube.fail.direktion: The directorate. The capsule comes back with a note: ‘Please use the official channels.’
strings.mg.tube.fail.kantine: In the canteen the capsule drops out of the tube next to the soup. They send it back, lukewarm.
strings.mg.tube.fail.planarchiv: The plan archive in the cellar. The capsule comes back with dust, nothing else.
strings.mg.tube.fail.loge: Returned: the capsule comes back to the porter’s lodge. The porter looks over his glasses.
strings.mg.tube.fail.jam: The capsule jams at switch {n}. A tap with the pencil, and it slides back.
strings.mg.tube.fail.frozen: The line is frozen. The capsule sticks and slowly slides back.
strings.mg.tube.fail.lost: The capsule can’t get any further and slides back.
strings.mg.tube.solved: All three capsules have arrived. The librarian puts the sandwich aside for later and says nothing.
strings.mg.tube.hint.1: Tip: Follow the tube backwards from the reading room to the porter’s lodge. Every switch on that route must join exactly the two tubes the capsule comes in by and goes on through.
strings.mg.tube.hint.2: Tip: Switch {n} is still set wrong.
strings.mg.tube.hint.3: Tip: The switches are set right. Now call the capsule.
strings.explore.karsk.morse.title: Do not weigh
strings.explore.karsk.morse.prompt: Help out at the Morse set
strings.explore.karsk.morse.text: The man on duty had gone for tea, so I took over the set. Routine I read along without looking: train 2417, forty minutes late, wagon 24-311. The last two words I had to read off the chart letter by letter, because they are not routine: do not weigh. I sent back ‘ПР’ – received – the way it’s done, and pasted the tape onto the form.
strings.explore.berlin.rohrpost.title: Three capsules
strings.explore.berlin.rohrpost.text: The switches of the in-house pneumatic post are set in the reading room on a board from 1938, the only thing in the building that still knows where the tubes run. Three capsules came from the porter’s lodge: a loan slip for a book about pigeons, an enquiry as to who turned up the heating – nobody will own up – and a sandwich for the librarian. Which capsule mattered most to the porter, he didn’t say. I think the third.
